change.summary: The exact-commit evidence validator now requires workflow trigger provenance and immutable artifact identity fields.

acceptance_added: event_name must be push or workflow_dispatch
ref must be a full refs/heads/* or refs/tags/* value
ref_type must be branch or tag
claim_boundary: This record proves the source contract was committed. It does not prove GitHub Actions execution, Vercel deployment, browser audio routing, or physical audibility.
privacy: No private chat, health, credential, payment, or personal material was stored.
